messages:
maria_support: FYI incoming support ticket from Acme — embeddings API intermittently returns "Dimension mismatch" and sporadic 500s + tail latency spikes. Customer says it happens under bursts of many small requests. example req id `req_0a9f3b`

devin_engineer: @maria_support can you paste the exact error and a sample request? also what are their dynamic batching settings (max_batch_size / coalesce_ms / route)?

maria_support: pasted sample payload and error:
```json
{
  "model": "embed-xlarge-v2",
  "input": ["short text", "another short text"],
  "headers": { "X-embed-dim": "512" }
}
```
error:
```
ValueError: returned vector length 1536 != expected 512
  File "server.py", line 321, in handle_request
    vec = model.embed(batch)
```

sam_sre: @devin_engineer I'm already digging into batcher metrics. Seeing a lot of very small requests clustered. Time series around the incident: burst at 12:34Z with tail latency spikes around the same time.

runtime-bot: Deploy: dynbatch-maxtime bumped to 50ms for embed-batcher-prod at 1749121200 by @deploy-cd (change: increase coalesce window for throughput) :package:

devin_engineer: that maxtime/coalesce bump would make small requests wait longer to form bigger batches. If client-supplied projection header is sometimes present and sometimes missing (eg due to retries), mixing them in one batch could cause the runtime to assume a single output dim and then break. Need: batching logs that show per-request meta + dims.

maria_support: Customer says their SDK adds header `X-embed-dim:512` for some offline paths. They also confirmed retries sometimes drop custom headers.

sam_sre: Batcher snapshot (recent):
```
batcher_metrics:
  incoming_rps: 1200
  small_requests(<20 tokens): 68%
  batch_sizes_count: {1:680, 2:210, 4:90, 8:15, 32+:5}
  coalesce_ms: 50
  max_batch_size: 64
  avg_queue_time_ms: 12
```

devin_engineer: plausible root cause: header-based client dim overrides are not being preserved across retries and the runtime merges requests assuming the model's native dim (1536). When a 512-dim request lands in that batch the post-processing asserts and throws dimension mismatch. Repro plan: run a replay with mixed headers, dynbatch coalesce_ms=50, max_batch_size=64 and watch for assertion.

maria_support: customer asked for a quick mitigation they can apply immediately.

devin_engineer: short-term mitigation options:
- pin their route to smaller batches: `max_batch_size=16` and `coalesce_ms=10` for their API key/route
- require server-side projection (preferred) and reject requests with header mismatch early with 400
- add an ingress validation that fails fast if header present but incompatible

sam_sre: I can patch their route to `max_batch_size=16, coalesce_ms=10` now and roll it in staging -> prod for this customer only. scheduling the change. :white_check_mark:

maria_support: pls do. I'll tell the customer to test after the change and share logs if any 500s remain.

devin_engineer: follow-ups for runtime: 1) make batcher preserve per-request projection metadata through coalescing and enforce homogeneous output dims in a batch (fail fast and return 4xx instead of 500), 2) add metric `dim_mismatch_count` and alert on >0.1% in 5m, 3) add an e2e test that mixes header/no-header with retries. I'll open a runtime bug and link this thread.

maria_support: customer confirmed error rate dropped substantially after route pin. they still forwarded two failing request logs with `req_0a9f3b` and `req_3cde21` showing 500s. sending them to you, @devin_engineer.

devin_engineer: received logs, starting a local repro. quick repro snippet (bash):
```bash
# repro: send mixed header requests rapidly
for i in {1..200}; do
  if (( i % 3 == 0 )); then
    curl -s -H "X-embed-dim: 512" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings &
  else
    curl -s -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings &
  fi
done; wait
```

devin_engineer: I'll add the runtime fix + alert and follow up here when the PR is up. tagging for postmortem: @sam_sre @maria_support @deploy-cd

runtime-bot: Incident ticket created: RT-2145 (embeddings dim_mismatch under dynbatch) — assigned to devin_engineer.

maria_support: thanks all — closing this support escalation for now, marking as mitigated while runtime fix is in progress. customer is happy with the temporary route pin. :tada:
